items.title: Klarna Expands Visa Partnership to Offer Flexible Payment Options Across Four Major Markets
items.summary: Klarna (NYSE:KLAR) has expanded its partnership with Visa (NYSE:V), enabling merchants using the Visa Acceptance Platform to offer Klarna’s payment solutions across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Europe without requiring separate technical integrations. The agreement allows businesses already operating on Visa’s payment acceptance infrastructure to introduce Klarna’s checkout options through their existing systems.

items.title: This Week In Digital Payment - Tech Boosts Nonprofit Fundraising Through Finix-LifeMoves Partnership
items.summary: Finix, a full-stack payment processor, has partnered with LifeMoves, a leading nonprofit tackling homelessness in Silicon Valley, to enhance donor payment systems. This collaboration allows LifeMoves to gain full control over its donor journey, reduce transaction costs, and implement modern payment solutions, including mobile giving and expanded digital options like Apple Pay and Google Pay.
